About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
We are seeking an Enterprise Account Executive to join the foundational team introducing Anthropic's frontier AI to large enterprises across Southeast Asia. Based in Singapore, you will drive adoption of safe, frontier AI by securing strategic deals with major corporations across industries including financial services, healthcare, technology, manufacturing, and telecommunications throughout the ASEAN region. You'll leverage your consultative enterprise sales expertise to grow revenue while becoming a trusted partner to C-suite and senior technical stakeholders, helping them embed Claude across business operations, research, and administration. As Anthropic's senior in-market commercial presence for ASEAN, you'll shape our regional go-to-market strategy and lay the groundwork for a dedicated Southeast Asia footprint.
Key responsibilities
Own and exceed revenue targets by winning new enterprise accounts and expanding existing relationships across ASEAN countries.
Serve as senior regional coverage for Anthropic's most strategic ASEAN enterprise accounts, building executive relationship depth and commercial momentum through consistent in-market engagement
Build and execute territory plans that identify high-value opportunities across key ASEAN industries, accounting for differences in market maturity, regulatory environment, and buying behaviour between countries
Lead consultative sales processes with C-suite and senior technical stakeholders, positioning AI as a strategic business transformation driver
Orchestrate internal teams—Product, Engineering, Applied AI, Partnerships—to deliver tailored solutions for complex enterprise requirements
Translate technical AI capabilities into compelling business value propositions suited to the needs of Southeast Asian enterprises
Identify new use cases and contribute to ASEAN go-to-market strategy, providing feedback that shapes product roadmap and regional approach
Represent Anthropic across Southeast Asia, building executive relationships with enterprise, partner, and government stakeholders and raising Anthropic's profile within the regional technology community
Minimum qualifications
12+ years in enterprise sales, GTM, business development, or account management with direct, in-market Southeast Asia operating experience
A track record of managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and securing strategic deals in ASEAN markets by translating multifaceted technical requirements into tailored solutions
Existing commercial network across enterprise and partner communities in Singapore and at least one or two additional ASEAN markets
Strong commercial instincts, with the ability to identify, prioritise, and advance high-value opportunities without heavy oversight
Comfort operating as a generalist regional presence—equally effective in an enterprise sales conversation, a partnership discussion, or a government stakeholder introduction
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with cultural fluency across ASEAN business environments
Based in, or willing to relocate to, Singapore, with eligibility to work in Singapore and the ability to travel frequently across Southeast Asia
Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience
Preferred qualifications
Experience selling AI/ML, cloud, data platforms, or enterprise SaaS to regulated industries such as financial services or healthcare
Experience working with hyperscaler or channel partners to co-sell into regional enterprise accounts
Prior experience establishing or scaling a new market or region for a high-growth technology company
Working proficiency in a Southeast Asian language in addition to English (e.g. Bahasa Indonesia, Thai, Vietnamese)
Familiarity with regional data residency, AI governance, and procurement frameworks relevant to enterprise buyers
A passion for and/or experience with advanced AI systems, and a strong interest in ensuring frontier AI is developed safely
Logistics
Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit
anthropic.com/careers
directly for confirmed position openings.
How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
Come work with us!
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.

That question is answered by the Speed Measurement and Analytics team within Customer Experience and Business Trends (CXBT), and as a Business Intelligence Engineer I on this team, you will help build the answer. If you are curious, analytical, and energized by turning large-scale data into clear, actionable insights, this is a great opportunity to grow your career while shaping decisions that matter. Key job responsibilities - Build and maintain data pipelines, ETL jobs, and data models that power competitive delivery-speed benchmarking across your assigned geography or horizontal function, ensuring data freshness, accuracy, and completeness. - Write and optimize SQL/PySPARK queries to produce weekly and monthly speed benchmark reports, translating raw data into actionable insights for regional leads and senior leadership. - Collaborate with Product Managers, Program Managers, and peer Business Intelligence Engineers to align data definitions, standardize metrics, and support the onboarding of new geographies into the benchmarking platform. - Investigate data anomalies, root-cause quality issues, and implement validation checks so that discrepancies are caught before they reach stakeholders. - Maintain clear documentation of your data artifacts and analytical methodology, and identify opportunities to automate manual processes for improved pipeline reliability and reporting efficiency. A day in the life You will start your day checking pipeline health and dashboard accuracy for your assigned geography, then move into writing or refining SQL queries that feed the latest benchmarking signals into Pulse. You might spend part of the afternoon investigating a data discrepancy flagged by a regional lead, or meeting with a Product Manager to scope a new competitive analysis. Between tasks you will review a teammate's code, update your documentation, and brainstorm ways to automate a manual reporting step. About the team The Speed Measurement and Analytics team sits within Amazon's Customer Experience and Business Trends (CXBT) organization. Our mission is to give Worldwide Stores a single, trusted view of how Amazon's delivery speed compares to competitors globally. We are a collaborative group of Business Intelligence Engineers and Product Managers working together to expand coverage to new geographies and new speed signals. Joining now means you will help build, not just maintain, the platform that shapes Amazon's speed investment strategy.

Develop and implement internal processes to support compliance with global regulatory obligations.
Work closely with SIE’s global litigation and competition counsel in the United States and other regions as part of a collaborative global team
Represent SIE’s interests before authorities and agencies.
Manage litigation and matters before regulatory agencies involving SIE, partnering with outside counsel and managing litigation budgets.

Work globally to implement worldwide business and policy strategies.

Partner with SIE Government Affairs on SIE’s public policy initiatives with respect to competition and other related issues.

15+ years’ post-qualification experience (PQE) with substantial experience leading complex litigation matters, alongside additional exposure to advising on competition and/or regulatory issues within large-scale, complex environments.

Substantial experience advising clients responding to subpoenas, RFIs, CIDs, and interview requests from competition authorities and other regulatory agencies.

Data-driven mentality and ability to identify and recommend the best course of action even in ambiguous situations.

대출 분야에서는 업계 최고 수준의 리워드를 제공하는 와우 신용 카드 (제휴)를 빠르게 확장시키고 있습니다. 쿠팡 입점 사업자(셀러)의 사업 성장을 위해 쿠팡페이는 한국 최초의 BaaS (Banking as a Service) 기능을 사용하여 다양한 유동성 옵션을 구축하고 있습니다.
금융과 기술을 결합한 핀테크 분야 내에서 광범위한 경험을 쌓으며 업무하시길 원한다면, 쿠팡 페이와 함께 하세요. 우리는 고객이 계산하는 시간을 줄여서 고객이 좋아하는 것을 쇼핑하는 데 더 많은 시간을 보낼 수 있도록 돕습니다.

숙련된 경험을 바탕으로 다양한 이해관계자와 긴밀히 협업하며, 본인의 디자인 비전과 아이디어를 구체화하고 최고 수준의 프로덕트를 설계할 수 있는 역량을 요구합니다.

전체적인 문제 해결사 (Holistic Problem Solver): 리더는 체계적으로 사고하고 직관과 근거(데이터, 모범 사례 벤치마크, 테스트 및 분석 등)를 활용하여 복잡한 고객 문제에 대한 혁신적인 해결책을 찾아야 합니다.

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.
We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
As a Principal Software Engineer on the Compute team, you will be the technical anchor for Roblox's GPU and AI accelerator capabilities. This is a battle-tested GPU expert role focused on the machine management layer and above: how GPU hosts are made production-ready, kept healthy, and turned into reliable compute for the workloads that depend on them. You will own the hard problems that show up only at scale, from driver and firmware management to GPU health, reliability, and performance across a rapidly growing fleet of accelerators spanning Roblox data centers and cloud environments. You will set the technical direction for GPU compute and up-level the entire organization's GPU expertise.
You will:
Serve as the GPU technical leader for the Compute team, partnering across Kubernetes, Machine Bootstrap, Networking, and Cloud to drive GPU strategy end to end.
Own the GPU host lifecycle above raw fleet management: driver, firmware, and CUDA stack management, GPU health and telemetry, and remediation of GPU-specific failures (XID errors, ECC, thermal, NVLink and fabric faults).
Architect how GPU capacity is exposed to compute platforms, including scheduling, isolation, and integration with Kubernetes for GPU and AI workloads.
Drive GPU reliability and performance at fleet scale, defining the detection, diagnosis, and automated repair of unhealthy accelerators before they impact production.
Evaluate and onboard new GPU and AI accelerator platforms, networking topologies (NVLink, InfiniBand, RoCE), and multi-node training and inference patterns.
Establish the standards, tooling, and APIs that let other engineering teams consume GPU compute safely and efficiently, reducing toil and raising the bar for the org.
You have:
10+ years of experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems and infrastructure.
Deep, hands-on GPU expertise at the machine management layer and above: GPU host provisioning, driver and firmware lifecycle, GPU health and reliability, and the realities of running accelerators in production.
A track record as an expert for compute, not just fleet management, with the scars to prove you have scaled GPU or accelerator infrastructure that other teams depend on.
Strong proficiency in Go or other well-structured programming languages.
Experience operating GPU and AI workloads in production, including familiarity with CUDA, GPU scheduling, and high-performance networking (NVLink, InfiniBand, RoCE).
Familiarity with Kubernetes for GPU workloads and with bare-metal concepts (firmware, BMC/IPMI/Redfish, OS imaging) is a strong plus.
A history of being the anchor expert that an organization relies on for its hardest GPU and compute problems, and the leadership to up-level the engineers around you.
